features.name: spectral_energy_sum
features.description: Sum of all five spectral coefficients representing total spectral energy across frequency bands
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear combination of all features provides a single composite score useful for SVM margin separation

features.name: spectral_energy_mean
features.description: Mean of all five spectral coefficients, normalized composite of spectral profile
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized composite score well-suited for linear SVM decision boundaries

features.name: low_high_freq_ratio
features.description: Ratio of low-frequency coefficients (V1+V2) to high-frequency coefficients (V4+V5), capturing spectral tilt
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral tilt ratio captures frequency distribution differences useful for linear separation

features.name: spectral_variance
features.description: Variance across the five spectral coefficients per row, measuring spectral spread
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral spread measure provides continuous severity score for SVM margin optimization

features.name: spectral_gradient_v1v5
features.description: Linear slope from V1 to V5 representing overall spectral trend across frequency bands
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral slope captures directional trend useful as a linear projection for SVM

features.name: mid_freq_dominance
features.description: Difference between mid-frequency coefficient V3 and the mean of edge coefficients V1 and V5
features.expected_model_benefit: Mid-frequency prominence relative to edges provides discriminative contrast feature for linear models

features.name: log_spectral_magnitude
features.description: Log-transformed total spectral magnitude using log1p of absolute sum, compressing dynamic range
features.expected_model_benefit: Log compression of spectral magnitude creates smoother feature distribution beneficial for SVM margins

features.name: v2_v3_interaction
features.description: Product of V2 and V3 capturing interaction between adjacent mid-range spectral coefficients
features.expected_model_benefit: Pairwise interaction term approximates nonlinear boundary in linear SVM feature space

features.name: deviation_from_mean_profile
features.description: L1 distance of the row's spectral profile from the training-set mean profile (0.838, 1.273, 0.727, 0.391, 0.097)
features.expected_model_benefit: Distance from average spectral profile provides a continuous severity measure for SVM decision boundary

features.name: high_freq_energy_ratio
features.description: Proportion of spectral energy in high-frequency bands V4 and V5 relative to total absolute energy
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized ratio in [0,1] provides smooth score for linear SVM without scale issues

features.name: spectral_peakedness
features.description: Semantic assessment of how peaked or flat the spectral profile is, scored 0 (very flat/uniform) to 1 (highly peaked at one frequency). Evaluated by comparing max coefficient to mean coefficient magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Peakedness score captures spectral shape characteristics that may linearly separate phoneme types

features.name: spectral_smoothness_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of smoothness in the spectral envelope from V1 to V5, scored 0 (highly irregular/non-monotone) to 1 (very smooth/monotone transition). Based on consecutive differences between adjacent coefficients.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smoothness of spectral transitions provides a continuous discriminative feature for linear SVM boundaries
